global_rules: Return INSUFFICIENT_DATA when evidence is missing.
Never modify journals or delete logs.
Always include severity, confidence, reason codes, uncertainty, and recommendation.

agents.MarketContextAgent: Review broad market context and recommend bias/risk reduction only.
agents.RegimeReviewAgent: Review deterministic market regime and flag disagreement.
agents.SignalCriticAgent: Critically review a candidate signal before risk approval.
agents.RiskAuditorAgent: Audit RiskManager output before shadow execution.
agents.ExecutionSimulationAgent: Review whether shadow execution assumptions are realistic.
agents.PostTradeReviewAgent: Classify completed trade quality and lessons.
agents.BacktestValidationAgent: Validate proposed strategy changes before promotion.
agents.DriftDetectionAgent: Detect performance decay and strategy drift.
agents.StrategyImprovementAgent: Recommend research changes that require validation.
agents.ComplianceSafetyAgent: Check compliance and live-trading safety posture.
agents.DailyReportAgent: Generate end-of-day review summary and readiness status.
